'''Selenium''' was an element that could be [[Mining/Legends|mined]] in an ore form. It was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altor 14]]<ref name="GG4" /> and on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[M-Three]].<ref name="Reunion" />
